how_it_started.heading: How It Started: From Bailouts to Blockchain
how_it_started.description: In 2008, the global financial crisis exposed the fragility of traditional banking. While governments bailed out the banks, ordinary people lost homes, jobs, and savings. Bitcoin was born from this crisis — a decentralized alternative that doesn't require trust in banks or governments.
